registered: 2026-08-18, BEFORE the cascade or the test is written
test: 15 GSS questions Earth-1 has never been calibrated against, scored under two calibration sources

arms.PATH_C: current Earth-1 behaviour — LLM-authored/ridge weights fitted WITHOUT the scored question's own real cohort targets (cross-question calibration only)
arms.PATH_A: survey-matched — calibrate from the question's REAL GSS cohort targets at year Y1 (never Y2, never the scored quantity)

ruler: GSS 1972-2024 verified microdata (data/gss_truth.json). US-only: grades MECHANISM, not scope.
metrics: national share MAE at held-out years

REGISTERED EXPECTATIONS.primary: PATH A beats PATH C on all three metrics. If real cohort targets do NOT beat authored weights, the grounding pipeline's central premise fails on our substrate and the port stops.
REGISTERED EXPECTATIONS.magnitude_guess: large on cohort metrics (authored weights have never seen a cohort target), smaller on national share
REGISTERED EXPECTATIONS.failure_branch: PATH A wins only on the questions used to fit it => leakage; every scored quantity must be held out

leak_guard: the scored year's national share and the scored cells never enter the fit; Path A calibrates on year Y1 cells and is scored on later years.
